title: Align testimonial, contact form, and footer with Figma
context: The homepage root page at `/` should better match the existing Figma desktop and mobile frames. Figma sources: desktop https://www.figma.com/design/0J2JF0nYrI8EJrttdHNes4/Portfolio?node-id=1-549&t=AL7MiQ7CLvTxT4Cf-0 and mobile https://www.figma.com/design/0J2JF0nYrI8EJrttdHNes4/Portfolio?node-id=79-219&t=AL7MiQ7CLvTxT4Cf-0. Desktop should match closely, mobile should match the mobile frame, and tablet should scale from mobile using Figma auto-layout as a guide. This plan covers the lower homepage sections: testimonial quote treatment, contact form background and mobile gutters, and footer sizing/content alignment.

tasks.title: Match testimonial quote styling across desktop and mobile
acceptance_criteria: On desktop, the testimonial quote matches the Figma treatment with an approximately 7px white outside stroke
The quote gradient and stroke do not reduce readability or create visual artifacts at desktop sizes
On mobile, the testimonial quote has no outline
On mobile, the testimonial quote renders white instead of gradient text
The testimonial layout remains non-overlapping and accessible across desktop, tablet, and mobile widths
`npm run verify` passes after the change

tasks.title: Align contact form background and mobile gutters with Figma
acceptance_criteria: The contact form background uses the bg-flare asset anchored to the top right corner as shown in Figma
The contact background treatment scales cleanly without creating unwanted seams or overflow on desktop, tablet, or mobile
On mobile, the contact form gutter is only the site gutter
On mobile, the social links section has added padding so its text aligns with the availability card text below it
Contact form labels, inputs, buttons, and focus states remain accessible after the layout changes
`npm run verify` passes after the change

tasks.title: Tighten footer height, typography, and mobile logo behavior
acceptance_criteria: Footer height is reduced to match Figma more closely, including removing the roughly 10px excess height
The `Brent Walbolt` footer text is larger to match Figma
There is no visual gap between the contact area and footer
The bottom padding on `.homepage-module__ISUhRG__sectionStack` or its source CSS no longer creates a contact-to-footer gap
On mobile, the footer logo is hidden
Footer content remains semantically correct and keyboard/focus accessible
`npm run verify` passes after the change
